content:
incident-bot: ALERT: node-provisioning-failure in us-west2-prod and eu-west1-prod — image pulls failing from docker.io/nvidia/cuda. Triggered by autoscaler creating new GPU nodes; new nodes stuck in ImagePullBackOff. PagerDuty incident opened. Link: <https://status.redwood.ai/inc/1802345678>

pagerduty-bot: Paging mike (oncall) and sara (oncall). Severity: SEV2 — cluster capacity impaired.

mike (oncall): seeing the same here, kubelet logs show repeated failures on pull. example:
```
Failed to pull image "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1-runtime": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to fetch layer: Get https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/library/nvidia/cuda/blobs/sha256/...: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
Error syncing pod, skipping: failed to start container
```

sara (oncall): autoscaler tried to create 12 nodes across the two regions; 9 are failing during bootstrap with image pull errors, 3 succeeded (already had cache). We're losing effective GPU capacity for real-time inference pools.

mike (oncall): cause looks like Docker Hub rate-limit / partial outage for large layers from the nvidia repo. I can reproduce with a straight docker pull from our build machine: `docker pull docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1-runtime` -> intermittent 503/429/TLS timeouts.

carol (infra): opened a ticket with Docker Hub support — case DH-98765 — they've acknowledged elevated errors retrieving large blobs. Also pinged NVIDIA to see if their container registry has a mirror.

dave (sre): immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) point new node bootstrap to our internal mirror registry where we have pre-pulled images (registry.internal.redwood.ai/nvidia/cuda:12.1-rt) 2) create a pre-warmed nodepool with images pre-pulled and set cluster-autoscaler to prefer that pool for GPU workloads 3) temporarily disable autoscaler scale-up for GPU pools until mirror switch completes.

mike (oncall): working on a k8s patch to admission config for the nodepool. trying to patch the kubelet bootstrap args to replace `docker.io/nvidia/cuda` with `registry.internal.redwood.ai/nvidia/cuda`. Will post the rollout plan.

sara (oncall): quick stop-gap: creating a DaemonSet that runs `crictl pull` on existing nodes to populate cache, and another Job to seed the pre-warmed pool. Command I'm running now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra run prepull --image=registry.internal.redwood.ai/tools:latest --restart=OnFailure --command -- /bin/sh -c "for img in \"docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1-runtime\"; do ctr -n=k8s.io images pull --plain-http $img || true; done"
```
This will at least allow existing nodes to service pods while we fix scale-up.

carol (infra): updated terraform for nodepool to reference our mirror image arg; applying to us-west2-prod now (plan -> apply). If apply succeeds we can drain and replace failing nodes gradually.

mike (oncall): started changing cluster-autoscaler annotation to prefer pool `gpu-warm` and paused creation of new unmanaged nodes: `kubectl annotate deployment cluster-autoscaler autoscaler.kubernetes.io/scale-down-disabled=true` (temporary).

dave (sre): note for rollout: watch the kube-controller-manager events and node-provisioner logs. Example checks: `kubectl get nodes -o wide`, `kubectl describe node <node>` and `/var/log/kubelet` on the failing nodes. Look for errors like 'back-off pulling image' or 'image pull rate limited'.

sara (oncall): customers: we have telemetry showing ~14% of inference jobs hitting retries/failures over the last 30m in affected regions. Most traffic degraded (increased latency) rather than full errors — the fallback to cached instances mitigated some. Raising a customer-impact banner to support and sales so they can triage customers on enterprise plans.

carol (infra): Docker Hub responded: "We're seeing degraded performance for large blob downloads in certain regions; we're investigating. If you have mirrors or private registries we recommend switching temporarily." They've set a priority ticket.

mike (oncall): manual mitigation complete for us-west2: terraform apply succeeded, new nodes are provisioning from internal mirror. Kube cluster health improving — 6/8 pending nodes finished bootstrap using mirrored images. Monitoring for evicted pods.

dave (sre): reminder: ensure we have IAM/registry creds rotated and imagePullSecrets set for internal registry. I pushed a quick secret to `kube-system`: `kubectl create secret docker-registry internal-reg --docker-server=registry.internal.redwood.ai --docker-username=redwood-ci --docker-password=***`

sara (oncall): handing the incident to dave for night coverage at 03:30 UTC. Summary for handoff:
- Cause: third-party artifact delivery issues (Docker Hub) causing image pulls for large CUDA layers to fail during node bootstrap
- Impact: new GPU nodes failing to provision; ~14% of inference requests degraded in us-west2/eu-west1 for 00:15-03:20 UTC
- Mitigations applied: switched new node bootstrap to internal mirror, seeded caches via DaemonSet, paused autoscaler scale-up for GPU pools, contacted Docker Hub support
- Follow-ups: widen internal registry cache, automate mirror fallback in bootstrap, update runbook, coordinate postmortem and customer comms

dave (sre): taking it. I'll keep monitoring for 2 hours then call the follow-up sync. Notifying SRE rotation and posting an incident summary to #incidents-summary.

mike (oncall): one more thing — we should add a step in provisioning runbook: if Docker Hub returns 5xx/429 for >5 minutes, switch to `registry.internal.redwood.ai` and throttle autoscaler. I'll open a PR for the runbook now.

carol (infra): opened infra ticket INF-3211 to automate pre-warmed GPU pool and pre-pulled images. Also adding an observability alert: detect repeated ImagePullBackOff on node creation and auto-create fallback.

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity lowered to SEV3 — capacity recovering. Incident will remain open until postmortem created and follow-ups assigned.

dave (sre): note for postmortem: collect docker pull histograms, request traces showing retries, and support communication from Docker Hub. We should include per-region failure rates and customer-impact list.

sara (oncall): thanks everyone. handing off to dave — I'll be reachable if anything spikes.

--- end of thread ---
